notes: SYNTHETIC. No ARGUS or other export was available; every 'other system' here was built by examples/reconciliation/tie_out.py from FactLot's own output with one convention changed on purpose, and says nothing about how any product computes. The expected causes are the planted ones, stated in the builder; the year-3 differences of the rounded-downtime case are computed by hand there (0.45 of one month of Suite 100's rollover rent and recoveries). The remaining cases are small hand-built patterns on a two-lease property.
